access.deniedTitle: The call-center console isn't available to your account
access.deniedHint: It needs the Call Center Agent role. Ask an administrator to add it, then sign in again.
access.unavailableHint: The permission check for the call-center console could not be completed, so the console stays closed. This is a server problem, not a missing permission — try again shortly.

open.failedTitle: The order could not be opened
open.failedHint: Nothing was created. Try again, or go back to the portal.
open.malformedTitle: The order could not be read
open.malformedHint: The server answered in a way this console does not recognise, so no order is shown. Try again — if it keeps happening, this is a server problem worth reporting.

state.readFailed: That order could not be read. Nothing has changed on it — try again, or abandon it and start fresh.

busy.retrying: Another change is being applied to this order…
busy.keepTyping: Retrying on its own — carry on, nothing is lost.
busy.nothingLost: Nothing has changed and nothing is lost.

closed.submitted: This order has already been placed
closed.swept: This order timed out and was closed

fault.closedHint: It can no longer be changed. Start a new order to carry on.
fault.notYoursTitle: This order belongs to another session
fault.notYoursHint: It is not the order this account has open. Start again to get back to your own order.

contract.title: This console is out of date
contract.hint: The server is speaking version {{received}} of the order service and this console was built for version {{expected}}. It will not run rather than risk showing the wrong prices. Reload the page; if that does not help, ask for the console to be updated.

existing.titleNamed: You have an open order for {{name}}
existing.titleAnonymous: You have an open order with no caller attached yet
existing.note: Nothing is resumed automatically. If this is a different caller, abandon it and start fresh — that basket belongs to the previous call.

abandon.title: Abandon this order?
abandon.bodyNamed: The order for {{name}} will be voided. It cannot be brought back.
abandon.bodyAnonymous: This order will be voided. It cannot be brought back.
abandon.failed: The order could not be abandoned. Nothing has changed — try again.

rail.emptyHint: Type the number the caller is ringing from.
rail.notFound: No loyalty member has that number. Check it with the caller and search again.
rail.lookupFailed: The loyalty lookup could not be completed. Nothing has changed — try again.
rail.attachFailed: The caller could not be attached to this order. Nothing has changed — try again.
rail.removeFailed: The caller could not be removed from this order. Nothing has changed — try again.
rail.addressNeedsCaller: Attach the caller first — their address book opens with them.
rail.addressRetained: Their {{label}} address is kept — switch back to delivery and it is used again.

address.title: Pick the delivery address
address.loadFailed: The address book could not be read. Nothing has changed on this order — try again.
address.emptyBook: This caller has no addresses on file yet.
address.noLine: No street details on this address.
address.applyFailed: That address could not be applied. Nothing has changed on this order — try again.
address.refusedNoCaller: This order has no caller attached, so their address book is closed. Attach the caller again, then pick the address.
address.refusedNotTheirs: That address is on file for a different customer, so it was not applied. Pick one of this caller's own addresses — and if it should be theirs, it needs sorting out on the customer record.
address.refusedNoDeliveryStore: No store delivers to that district, so the order cannot be sent to that address. Nothing has changed on this order — tell the caller now, and try another address.

form.createTitle: Add an address for this caller
form.label: Label
form.districtSearchPlaceholder: Type a district or a city…
form.districtLoadFailed: The district list could not be read. Try again — nothing has been saved.
form.districtNone: No district or city matches that.
form.districtTruncated: Showing the first matches of {{total}}. Keep typing to narrow them.
form.phoneHint: The number the driver rings — not the caller's loyalty mobile.
form.shortAddressHint: Optional. Four letters then four digits — the format is checked here, the address itself is not verified.

errors.district: Pick the district. It is what decides which store delivers this order.
errors.shortAddress: A national address is four letters followed by four digits, e.g. RIMA6904.

form.createFailed: That address could not be added. Nothing has been saved — try again.
form.updateFailed: That correction could not be saved. The address is unchanged — try again.

store.title: Choose the fulfilment store
store.loadFailed: The store list could not be read. Nothing has changed on this order — try again.
store.noMatch: No store matches that. Try the store code, or the city.
store.truncated: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} matches — keep typing to narrow it.
store.applyFailed: That store could not be applied. Nothing has changed on this order — try again.

confirm.reissuedStale: The basket changed while you were reading the last preview, so this is a fresh one. Nothing has been applied.
confirm.reissuedExpired: The last preview expired before it was confirmed, so this is a fresh one. Nothing has been applied.

rebind.title: Move this order to {{store}}?
rebind.pricesCaption: Line totals, VAT included, in SAR
rebind.moneyStandsStill: No line changes price at the new store.
rebind.noLineMovement: Nothing in the basket changes price at the new store.
rebind.deliveryFeeMoved: The delivery fee becomes {{to}} instead of {{from}}.
rebind.atpReFrozen: {{line}}: availability re-freezes from {{from}} to {{to}} at the new store.
rebind.atpBelow: {{line}}: only {{to}} available at the new store (was {{from}}) — the line will be below availability.
rebind.wouldRefuse: This order cannot move to {{store}} as it stands:
rebind.voidThenRetry: The move is all-or-nothing, so nothing will be changed. Remove the line above, then move the order.
rebind.failed: The order could not be moved. Nothing has changed — try again.
rebind.refusedFallback: The order could not be moved to that store. Nothing has been changed.
rebind.nothingChanged: Nothing was changed — the order is exactly as it was.
rebind.lineRefused: no price at the new store

change.fulfilment: Change how this order is fulfilled

slot.title: Choose the delivery slot
slot.atStore: Windows offered by store {{store}}, the store this order is served from.
slot.loadFailed: The delivery windows could not be read. Nothing has changed on this order — try again.
slot.noneOffered: This store is offering no delivery windows at the moment.
slot.applyFailed: That slot could not be set. Nothing has changed on this order — try again.
slot.lapsedRefusal: That window has just gone. The slot on the order is unchanged — pick another one. The order can still be placed either way.
slot.lapsedWarning: The delivery slot on this order has lapsed. The order can still be placed — change the slot if the caller needs a firm window.

source.title: Document source and reference
source.referenceHint: What this order can be traced back to — the campaign, ticket or system that produced the call.
source.loading: Reading the sources you can use…
source.loadFailed: Your document sources could not be read. Nothing has changed on this order — try again.
source.noneForYou: No document sources are assigned to your account, so this order cannot be traced to one yet. Ask an administrator to assign you a source.
source.applyFailed: The source could not be saved. Nothing has changed on this order — try again.
source.refusedReferenceRequired: That source needs a reference, so nothing was saved. Enter the campaign, ticket or system reference and save again.

search.label: Search the catalogue
search.placeholder: Search items — name, Arabic name, or item number
search.minChars: Type at least {{min}} characters — part of the name, in English or Arabic, or the item number.
search.failed: The catalogue search could not be completed. Nothing has changed on this order — try again.
search.noMatch: Nothing matches that. Try part of the name, in English or Arabic, or the item number.
search.estimateNote: Catalogue prices are estimates before VAT — the basket price is what the caller pays.
search.truncated: Showing the first {{shown}} — narrow your search.
search.addFailed: That item could not be added. Nothing has changed on this order — try again.
search.addNotConfirmable: That item was not added: the store's availability could not be read to check it against. Try again.

belowAtp.recorded: The order can still be taken. Accepting is recorded against this line, so only accept what the caller has agreed to wait for.

add.title: More {{item}} than this store has — take the order anyway?

raise.title: More {{item}} than this store has — raise the line anyway?
raise.keep: Leave the quantity as it is

belowAtp.failed: That acceptance did not land, so nothing has changed on this order — try again.
belowAtp.raiseFailed: That acceptance did not land, so the quantity is unchanged. Nothing has changed on this order — try again.

refused.LINE_NOT_FOUND: That line is no longer on this order — the screen had fallen behind. Refresh the order to see what it holds now.
refused.UOM_NOT_AVAILABLE: This item does not come in that unit, so the line was left as it was.
refused.QTY_INVALID: That quantity was not accepted. Nothing has changed on the line — try a different quantity, or remove the line.
refused.fallback: That change was not applied. Nothing has changed on this order — try again.

guidance.heading: Offers within reach
guidance.none: No offers within reach of this basket.
guidance.getSideAbsent: Buy-one-get-one offers aren't checked yet — this list covers discounts only.
guidance.countedMark: already counted — a better offer applied
guidance.unavailable_one: {{count}} more offer can't be reached from this basket
guidance.unavailable_other: {{count}} more offers can't be reached from this basket
guidance.resolveFailed: The qualifying items could not be listed. Nothing has changed on this order — try again.
guidance.resolveEmpty: Nothing that qualifies is available at this store right now.
guidance.searchRest_one: Search the other {{count}} — filtered to this offer
guidance.searchRest_other: Search the other {{count}} — filtered to this offer
guidance.searchRestUnknown: Search the rest of the selection — filtered to this offer

outcome.firedOther: Added. A better offer fired instead:
outcome.didNotFire_one: Added — this offer still needs {{count}} more.
outcome.didNotFire_other: Added — this offer still needs {{count}} more.
outcome.didNotFirePlain: Added — this offer has not fired.

skip.NOT_DISCOVERED: can't be checked from this basket
skip.unknown: this offer isn't available on this order

guidance.needsCoupon: This offer needs a coupon — apply one on the Coupon chip above.
guidance.needsCoupon_other: These offers need a coupon — apply one on the Coupon chip above.

waivedReason.ThresholdReached: This basket is over the free-delivery threshold.
waivedReason.ConfiguredOverride: This order type carries no delivery fee.

submit.readToCaller: Read this number to the caller.
submit.fixSection: Fix the {{section}} on this order, then place it again.
submit.stillOpen: The order is still open — nothing has been lost.
submit.unavailableTitle: The order has not been placed yet
submit.failed: The order could not be placed. The order is still open — try again.

blockers.ALREADY_SUBMITTED: this order has already been placed
blockers.unknown: something else this order needs — refresh it to see what changed

swallowed.belowAtp: That item was not added. The order service accepted the answer but did not apply it — the basket is exactly as it was.
swallowed.storeChange: The store was not changed. The order service accepted the answer but did not apply it — the order is still at the store it was.
swallowed.hint: Nothing on the order has changed. Try the action again from the start; if it keeps happening, it needs raising.

fulfilment.title: Delivering, or collecting?

Delivery.title: Deliver to the caller
Delivery.consequence: Their address decides the fulfilment store, and the order needs a delivery slot.

PickInStore.title: They collect in store
PickInStore.consequence: You choose the store. No address, no slot, and no delivery fee.

fulfilment.backToDelivery: Switching back to delivery re-derives the store from the address this order kept — if that moves the store, you will be asked to confirm it first.

locked.DELIVERY_ONLY_SOURCE: This order came from a source that is delivered, never collected, so the fulfilment cannot be changed.
locked.unknown: This order's fulfilment cannot be changed.

fulfilment.failed: The fulfilment could not be changed. Nothing has changed on this order — try again.

payment.title: How are they paying?

cashOnDelivery.title: Cash on delivery
cashOnDelivery.detail: The driver collects payment on the doorstep.

payOnCollection.title: Pay on collection
payOnCollection.detail: They pay at the counter when they collect the order.

paidOnline.title: Paid online
paidOnline.detail: A payment link is sent to the caller and settled before the order is dispatched.

payment.failed: The payment type could not be changed. Nothing has changed on this order — try again.

locked.PAYMENT_TYPE_FORCED: This order must be paid online before it is dispatched, so the payment type cannot be changed.
locked.unknown: The payment type on this order cannot be changed.

coupon.title: Coupon
coupon.codePlaceholder: Read the code from the caller
coupon.readBack: Read the code back to the caller before you apply it — applying redeems it straight away.

shut.NO_CUSTOMER: Attach the caller first — a coupon is redeemed against them.
shut.STORE_NOT_CHOSEN: Choose the store first — a coupon is redeemed against the store the order ships from, and that cannot be moved afterwards.
shut.ORDER_CLOSED: This order is no longer open.
shut.unknown: A coupon cannot be applied to this order right now.

signup.title: New loyalty member
signup.spokenWait: Ask the caller to read back the code we have just sent them.
signup.createdHint: Signed up. Attach them to this order.
